title: MHFW Releases 'Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan' Guidelines Expanding to 7x7x7 Framework
summary: Adds Low Birth Weight babies and Eating Right to transition from T3 to T4 approach.

blocks.title: 📰 1. 💰 ESI, FINANCE & BUSINESS NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 MHFW Releases 'Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan' Guidelines Expanding to 7x7x7 Framework. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Adds Low Birth Weight babies and Eating Right to transition from T3 to T4 approach.
7x7x7 Expansion: Expands 6x6x6 to 7x7x7 by adding LBW babies (0-6 months), 'Eating Right' intervention, and M&E framework.
T4 Approach: Transitions from Test, Treat, Talk to Test, Treat, Talk & Track.
IV Iron Therapy: Includes Intravenous Iron Therapy (Ferric Carboxymaltose) for severe anemia in pregnant women.
New beneficiary group (LBW babies 0-6 months) vs T4 approach (adds 'Track').
